with metadata_asof as (
    select s.*, i.trip_station_id as trip_station_id_at_collection,

      on s.station_id = i.station_id and i.snapshot_at_utc <= s.snapshot_at_utc
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by s.station_id, s.snapshot_id

    select *,
        case when bikes_available is null or docks_available is null then 'missing_counts'

        case when capacity_at_collection is null then 'unknown_capacity'
             when capacity_at_collection <= 0 then 'nonpositive_capacity'
             when bikes_available is null or docks_available is null
                  or bikes_available < 0 or docks_available < 0 then 'invalid_counts'
             when bikes_available + docks_available > capacity_at_collection then 'exceeds_known_capacity'

        lag(snapshot_at_utc) over station_history as previous_snapshot_at_utc,

with normalized as (
    select
        nullif(trim(ride_id), '') as ride_id,
        lower(nullif(trim(rideable_type), '')) as rideable_type,
        lower(nullif(trim(member_casual), '')) as rider_type,
        started_at as raw_started_at, ended_at as raw_ended_at,
        datetime(started_at, 'UTC') as started_at_local,
        datetime(ended_at, 'UTC') as ended_at_local,
        nullif(trim(start_station_id), '') as start_trip_station_id,
        nullif(trim(end_station_id), '') as end_trip_station_id,
        start_station_name, end_station_name,
        start_lat as start_latitude, start_lng as start_longitude,
        end_lat as end_latitude, end_lng as end_longitude,
        ingested_at as ingested_at_utc, gcs_path, source_url, source_checksum
    from `ba882-bluebikes-pipeline`.`raw`.`historical_trips`
    qualify row_number() over (
        partition by ride_id order by ingested_at desc, source_checksum desc, started_at desc
    ) = 1
), converted as (
    select *,
        timestamp(started_at_local, 'America/New_York') as started_at_utc,
        timestamp(ended_at_local, 'America/New_York') as ended_at_utc
    from normalized
), quality as (
    select *,
        case
            when started_at_local is null or ended_at_local is null then 'missing_time'
            when datetime(started_at_utc, 'America/New_York') != started_at_local
              or datetime(ended_at_utc, 'America/New_York') != ended_at_local
                then 'nonexistent_local_time'
            when datetime(timestamp_add(started_at_utc, interval 1 hour), 'America/New_York') = started_at_local
              or datetime(timestamp_sub(started_at_utc, interval 1 hour), 'America/New_York') = started_at_local
              or datetime(timestamp_add(ended_at_utc, interval 1 hour), 'America/New_York') = ended_at_local
              or datetime(timestamp_sub(ended_at_utc, interval 1 hour), 'America/New_York') = ended_at_local
                then 'ambiguous_local_time'
            when ended_at_utc < started_at_utc then 'negative_duration'
            else 'valid'
        end as trip_time_quality
    from converted
)

with requests as (select * from `ba882-bluebikes-pipeline`.`intermediate`.`int_availability_prediction_requests`),

    select p.prediction_id, h.inventory_observation_id as lag_observation_id,
        h.source_available_at_utc as lag_available_at_utc,
        h.reported_at_utc as lag_reported_at_utc,
        coalesce(h.is_bike_observation_usable and timestamp_diff(
            timestamp_sub(p.prediction_at_utc,interval 60 minute),h.reported_at_utc,second
        ) between 0 and 60*60,false) as has_lag_inventory,
        h.bikes_available as lag_bikes
    from requests p left join `ba882-bluebikes-pipeline`.`marts`.`fct_station_inventory_history` h
      on p.station_id=h.station_id
      and h.source_available_at_utc<=timestamp_sub(p.prediction_at_utc,interval 60 minute)
    qualify row_number() over(partition by p.prediction_id order by h.source_available_at_utc desc,h.inventory_observation_id desc)=1
), trip_profile as (
    -- Match original trip codes to the code known at the origin, never to a future GBFS bridge.
    -- Whole-hour groups are withheld until their latest contributing ingestion is available.
    select p.prediction_id,
        sum(if(e.endpoint_type='departure',e.endpoint_count,null)) as observed_departures_matching_hour_lookback,
        sum(if(e.endpoint_type='arrival',e.endpoint_count,null)) as observed_arrivals_matching_hour_lookback,
        count(distinct date(e.hour_at_utc,'America/New_York')) as trip_history_observed_dates,
        max(e.latest_source_ingested_at_utc) as trip_history_available_at_utc,
        max(e.hour_at_utc) as trip_history_latest_event_hour_utc
    from requests p left join `ba882-bluebikes-pipeline`.`intermediate`.`int_trip_endpoints_hourly` e
      on p.origin_trip_station_id=e.trip_station_id
      and e.latest_source_ingested_at_utc<=p.prediction_at_utc
      and e.hour_at_utc>=timestamp_sub(p.prediction_at_utc,interval 56 day)
      and timestamp_add(e.hour_at_utc,interval 1 hour)<=p.prediction_at_utc
      and extract(hour from datetime(e.hour_at_utc,'America/New_York'))=p.target_local_hour
      and extract(dayofweek from date(e.hour_at_utc,'America/New_York'))=p.target_local_day_of_week
    group by p.prediction_id
), weather as (
    select p.prediction_id,w.weather_record_id,w.weather_at_utc,w.available_at_utc as weather_available_at_utc,
        w.forecast_fetched_at_utc as weather_fetched_at_utc,

      and w.available_at_utc<=p.prediction_at_utc
      and w.is_future_at_available_time and w.weather_at_utc>p.prediction_at_utc
    qualify row_number() over(partition by p.prediction_id
        order by w.available_at_utc desc,w.forecast_fetched_at_utc desc,w.weather_record_id desc)=1
)
